name: la-carafa-des-bles-platform
description: Full-stack artisan bakery platform with React frontend, Express API, and MySQL persistence

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
